custom-app-id-toggle-comment: Toggle on to allow custom discord application id's. If off, will use the default game application.
large-image-key-comment: Image identifier for the application thumbnail
large-image-text-comment: The text shown when hovering over the image
large-image-url-comment: Url to redirect to when clicking on the image
small-image-key-comment: Image identifier for the application sub-image
small-image-text-comment: The text shown when hovering over the image
small-image-url-comment: Url to redirect to when clicking on the image
